primary_contrast.contrast_label: control; control vs stage 3; Botrytis cinerea

2_stress_module_deepdive.annotation_note: GO IDs and UniProt keywords from proteins.go_terms / keywords. No KEGG pathway table is deposited in this atlas; keyword enrichment is the KEGG-style functional-class proxy.
2_stress_module_deepdive.honesty: Primary scope = FDR-significant Botrytis stage-3 down ∩ Tier A∪B only. All other contrast×direction GO/keyword tests are exploratory and must not be cited as confirmed pathway hits. Enrichment is descriptive hypergeometric overlap on UniProt annotations — not g:Profiler/clusterProfiler with ontology propagation, and not KEGG pathway analysis.

6_string_stress_seed_hubs.honesty: STRING combined_score neighborhoods are descriptive adjacency (experiments/databases/coexpression/textmining mixed) — not LLPS evidence. Stress hubs use Pearson r on short Atlas log2FC vectors from the modules pass (Tier A seeds). Combined rank blends available STRING and stress ranks.

7_isoform_multi_protein_genes.honesty: Grouping key = VIT_* locus IDs parsed from UniProt gene_name / gene_names. UP000009183 is nearly one UniProt accession per VIT locus, so multi-accession isoform sets are rare. Score deltas are PlantLLPS hybrid score spreads across accessions of the same VIT — not experimentally confirmed splice-isoform LLPS differences. Shared gene symbols that map to distinct VIT IDs (paralogs) are intentionally excluded from this deposit.
